arguments.reason: This lens audits root reachability, owner-local initial entry, event-consumer coverage, and endpoint existence across PumpControl's three concurrent regions. This makes the NL3 owner-local initial-entry contract for PumpState violated (S2: PumpControl -> PumpState edge does not exist; only PumpControl -> InitialState exists), and the NL4/NL5 sequential transition contracts (PumpState->WaterState, WaterState->MethaneState) are absent from the complete transition inventory entirely (no such edges exist at all, in addition to being unreachable), so those are S2 missing-edge candidates on the exact absent source/target pair. Additionally, all four events show declared-but-unreachable consumers per inspection-equivalent/verify facts, which grounds one derived event_consumer_coverage obligation, since the operating regions that must respond to Activate/Deactivate Pump and Start/Stop Monitoring can never fire. This is causally rooted in PumpControl's synthetic-only local entry (a single unconditional edge to InitialState, a leaf with no outgoing transition), which itself is already covered by the NL3-INITENTRY-1 obligation, so I add one additional derived reachability contract capturing that the three concurrent operating regions (PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState) required by NL2/NL3/NL4/NL5 are never reachable from root, distinct from the narrower owner-local initial-entry defect and from the event-consumer coverage defect.

branches.reason: This lens audits root reachability, owner-local initial entry, event-consumer coverage, and endpoint existence across PumpControl's three concurrent regions. The closed FCSTM shows PumpControl's local initial edge goes only to a synthetic InitialState leaf (no outgoing transitions), so none of PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState or their nested initial edges are reachable from root. This makes the NL3 owner-local initial-entry contract for PumpState violated (S2: PumpControl -> PumpState edge does not exist; only PumpControl -> InitialState exists), and the NL4/NL5 sequential transition contracts (PumpState->WaterState, WaterState->MethaneState) are absent from the complete transition inventory entirely (no such edges exist at all, in addition to being unreachable), so those are S2 missing-edge candidates on the exact absent source/target pair. Additionally, all four events show declared-but-unreachable consumers per inspection-equivalent/verify facts, which grounds one derived event_consumer_coverage obligation, since the operating regions that must respond to Activate/Deactivate Pump and Start/Stop Monitoring can never fire. This is causally rooted in PumpControl's synthetic-only local entry (a single unconditional edge to InitialState, a leaf with no outgoing transition), which itself is already covered by the NL3-INITENTRY-1 obligation, so I add one additional derived reachability contract capturing that the three concurrent operating regions (PumpState/WaterState/MethaneState) required by NL2/NL3/NL4/NL5 are never reachable from root, distinct from the narrower owner-local initial-entry defect and from the event-consumer coverage defect.
